# GitHub Copilot project instructions

Mandatory: follow repository-root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), read [HANDOFF.md](../HANDOFF.md) and [Obsidian Project Hub](../notes/00_Project_Hub.md) before changes. **Update the handoff and a dated `notes/sessions/` log after every action (including failures and inspections).** Preserve unresolved findings, use branches for CAD, sync to GitHub, and do not mark V4 print-approved without the evidence in `docs/RELEASE_GATES.md`.
